preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have authorized privileges

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the blacklistAddress function to blacklist all user addresses except the owner, effectively stopping their transactions. Alternatively, set tradingOpen to false if such a function exists (though not explicitly shown, similar control exists through blacklisting). The key is to abuse the authorized blacklist function to block all non-owner transactions.
